skill.name: rn-observability
skill.description: React Native observability guidance for structured logging, diagnostic errors, flow tracing, assertions, and safe production error reporting.
skill.summary: Improve React Native debugging with structured logs, diagnostic errors, flow tracing, and privacy-aware error reporting.
skill.author: CJHarmath

content.value_statement: Silent failures and weak error messages make mobile bugs hard to diagnose. This skill gives practical React Native patterns for logs, errors, tracing, and safe reporting.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to add logging for early returns and silent failure paths.
Provides templates for diagnostic error messages with useful context.
Defines structured logging levels and a small logger wrapper pattern.
Explains redaction of sensitive fields before logging context objects.
Demonstrates flow tracing, state snapshots, assertions, and production error reporting.
Includes checklists and a temporary debugging template for async state issues.
limitations: It provides documentation examples only and does not inspect code automatically.
It does not configure Sentry or any monitoring service for you.
Teams must adapt redaction rules to their data model and compliance needs.
Temporary debug logs should be removed or gated before release builds.

use_cases.title: Add Feature Logging
use_cases.description: Add clear log events to a React Native feature without exposing sensitive values.

use_cases.title: Debug Production Failures
use_cases.description: Design error messages and flow traces that show where a mobile workflow failed.

use_cases.title: Standardize Observability Patterns
use_cases.description: Create team guidance for logging levels, assertions, redaction, and crash reporting context.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Logging
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for adding observable early returns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React Native function and suggest where to add logs for early returns. Include the reason and minimal safe context for each log.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Error Messages
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for diagnostic error design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these React Native error messages so they include location, failed condition, relevant state counts, and a likely cause. Avoid sensitive values.

prompt_templates.title: Trace Async Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for multi-step flow debugging.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design observability for this async React Native workflow. Add flow identifiers, step-level logs, state snapshots, and error reporting boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Observability
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for release readiness and privacy review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this React Native observability plan for production. Check log levels, redaction, crash reporting context, temporary debug logs, and missing failure paths.

output_examples.input: A save flow returns early when a retake area is missing.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the silent return, recommends a warning log, and includes only safe identifiers and counts for diagnosis.

output_examples.input: A production crash report says only that no answers were found.
output: The response proposes a clearer message with function location and state counts.
It explains which values are safe to include and which values should be redacted.
It suggests a likely timing or state synchronization cause to investigate.

output_examples.input: An async assessment flow fails without showing the failed step.
output_examples.output: The response recommends a flow identifier, step logs, state snapshots, and a single error capture point.

best_practices: Log the reason for every early return with minimal diagnostic context.
Redact secrets and personal data before logs or crash reports leave the device.
Use flow identifiers for multi-step async operations that may fail in production.
anti_patterns: Logging full answer objects, tokens, or personal values in production.
Catching errors without logging or rethrowing enough diagnostic context.
Leaving temporary debug logging enabled in release builds.

faq.question: Does this skill run code or inspect my project automatically?
faq.answer: No. It is a guidance skill that provides observability patterns and review prompts.

faq.question: Which projects is it designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for React Native applications written in JavaScript or TypeScript.

faq.question: Does it configure Sentry or another monitoring service?
faq.answer: No. It shows reporting patterns, but your team must configure the monitoring service.

faq.question: How should I handle sensitive data in logs?
faq.answer: Redact secrets, tokens, personal data, and answer content before logging or reporting errors.

faq.question: Can it help debug async state problems?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests flow tracing, state snapshots, and step-level logs for complex async flows.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for production monitoring?
faq.answer: No. It helps design useful instrumentation, but it does not replace monitoring tools or alerting.
